name: cmu-re-gui-ws-fix
author: CMU-Revised
description: The stock HMI message handler holds some screen messages in a reorder queue that never releases them properly: focus changes (for example to CarPlay or Android Auto) and screen transitions get lost, and screen changes can lag. This delivers every message in arrival order instead. Uninstall and restart to get the stock behaviour back.

files.reason: the MMUI onmessage handler delivers every message in arrival order; the stock reorder queue lost focusStack/transition messages
